readiness_trigger.next_action: Retain upstream runtime/E2E/model/instrumentation seals, then resolve the listed retained readiness inputs in the owned queue. No ready comparison remains unrun.

execution_rule.order: Canonical repository order on first repetition, reverse on second, rotate first arm to last on third; same case order and fresh isolated stores
execution_rule.model: Use the same precommitted newest-supported model/answer-context panel for comparable memory arms; use each upstream's supported native capture/extraction path. Preserve account/provider identity. No incumbent default or new paid route is implied.
execution_rule.preflight: Retain unsupported role/model interfaces, absent test recipes, failed installations and spending/entitlement constraints with source-backed reasons; never silently omit a survivor. Licence provenance is metadata only, never an exclusion ground.
execution_rule.cost: Record complete provider usage and elapsed time separately from tool-output/token estimates; never infer provider savings
execution_rule.protected_window: Heavy E2E during the CC's Monday window uses systemd-run --user --scope -p CPUWeight=idle; a full suite additionally needs SUITE-REQUEST and SUITE-GO.

fixed_decision_rule.eligibility: For each predeclared role, every mapped role check must pass in all three repetitions with complete usage and upstream E2E at the comparison's immutable source pin. Dependency arms qualify only their mapped interface and are never scored as standalone end-to-end candidates.
fixed_decision_rule.rank: Within each real role, rank all qualifying arms by pooled exact grounded-correct recall/usefulness on the same presealed newest-supported-model panels, then complete provider cost, median elapsed time and peak RSS. Native-file controls are diagnostic, not protected incumbents.
fixed_decision_rule.tie: Record equal qualified results as co-qualified for the measured role; no automatic incumbent retention and no superiority claim. No memory backend or default is preselected.
fixed_decision_rule.none_qualify: Record RETIRED for the unsupported role with all failure/retirement reasons; do not promote an unqualified arm.
fixed_decision_rule.terminal: FINAL requires every selected deployed winner's actual final-stack runs[] pin to match its adopted tested source, with verdict/wave/next_review, upstream E2E at that operational run pin and invoke evidence/role reason. An experimental source-pin receipt does not qualify a different historical operational run pin.
fixed_decision_rule.amendments: No new candidates or changed metrics after first run. Any necessary input correction requires a separately reviewed, hashed amendment before affected scoring.

model_policy.seal_rule: Resolve and commit exact newest supported model revisions, licenses, common answer-model/context and memory extraction/embedding/reranking settings from this fixed retained universe before the first capture or scoring. Use the same primary model panel and equal case/model weights for comparable memory arms. Older installed defaults are diagnostic controls, never a protected selection. No model is chosen from comparison outcomes.
model_policy.missing_input: Committed primary-source model/prompt/settings seal; no unresolved model alias is a pin.
model_policy.decision_basis: Measured merit on the newest supported models, including the Hindsight versus ai-memory trial. The Mac-only 10-02 deployment nonselection is background history, not a merit disposition or omission.

role_assignment_rule: Source-advertised roles enter the common requirement comparison; no applicability change at scoring. Distinct native output contracts use separately defined oracles, never incompatible layout requirements imposed on flat output.

role_reconciliation.requirement_basis: The layer requires shared memory and native capture across clients. The transcript arm cases 0-5 equal shared_memory_backend plus native_memory_capture; transcript indexing challenges the same recall/capture requirements.
previous_mandatory_checks: Read identical isolated cross-client fixture transcripts with exact source references
No substitute private transcript or protected source is ingested
role_reconciliation.qualification_boundary: Role applicability is a preregistered comparison obligation, not a claim that this arm passed the common oracle or supports every required operation.

role_reconciliation.requirement_basis: The pinned README advertises the common requirement role; it must enter the same-role comparison before any run.
role_reconciliation.qualification_boundary: Advertised source capability is not an executed capture, retrieval or E2E result.
